reviews.title: I needed zipties to make it work.
reviews.comment: This not working with icue out of the box is a big miss. Needing to buy a separate component when icue hubs are so plentiful seems wasteful. I’m using four strips in the picture. There need to be more options for running 3 strips together as it’s basically required for motherboard cables. I ended up using zip ties around the ends to secure them together but that’s kinda ridiculous right?
reviews.author: Adam J Anderson

reviews.title: USE DISCRETION!!
reviews.comment: Ordered one set of ARGB strips and was gifted another set from this listing. While both sets of ARGB strips looked new and work fine, both boxes had clearly been opened. One box was even missing some clips and came with a damaged, chewed-up SATA power cable for the lights. In short, RGB strips worked, but products were not new as a whole.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Looks perfect!
reviews.comment: These were very easy to install and look great! There’s not much information out there but you can use the commander duo for this and works as it should.
